## Purpose

Read-only consumption of the whole event stream to produce regulatory reports, audit trails, client statements and surveillance.

## Depends on

- [`15-reconciliation`](15-reconciliation.md) — Reconciliation
- [`16-kyc-aml`](16-kyc-aml.md) — KYC / AML / Fraud
- [`17-payments`](17-payments.md) — Payments and Treasury

## Depended on by

_nothing depends on this module yet._

## Inputs

- all domain events

## Outputs

- regulatory reports
- audit trails
- client statements
- risk reports
- surveillance alerts

## What gets built

- reporting projections in an analytical store
- regulatory report generation and submission adapters
- client statement generation
- trade surveillance rules
- record retention and legal hold

## Invariants

These are executed as tests at gate **G4**. A module may not declare an
invariant it does not test.

- INV-170: compliance never writes to the financial core.
- INV-171: any report is reproducible from the event log at a stated point in time.
- INV-172: retention and legal hold cannot be bypassed by a normal deletion path.

## Test obligations

- report reproducibility from a replayed log
- point-in-time correctness (as-of reporting)
- surveillance rule fixtures

## Known failure modes

The things that go wrong in systems like this one. Each should map to a test above.
